stem.en: In the Lijjat cooperative, who owns the business and how are the profits shared?

text.en: The seven founders own it, and new members earn a daily wage.
Outside investors own it, and members get a small part of sales.
Every member is an equal owner, and profits are shared equally.
Senior members own more of it, so they take a larger share.

explanation.en: Lijjat is a cooperative society. Every member who joins is an equal owner, and profits are shared equally, whether a member is senior or new.

hints.en: Think about what the women decided when they started a cooperative society.
